description: Separate post-training synthetic-contrast evaluation (design section 8, H2; OD1 for presets; deviation D-e). Optional `group_images_fn` hooks in ValidationSet.build / DeformValidationSet.build (default None = today's images[idx], in-training validation unchanged); 11 EVAL_PRESETS + `preset_params` in data_loading/synth.py; runtime/eval_run.py with the config rebuild (int-key normalisation), model/frozen-stage restore read-only from <run>/ckpt/last, sanity gate, per-preset synthetic sets built once and shared by both models, JSON/CSV output; top-level eval_synth.py CLI; scripts/compare_synth_eval.py; slurm/eval_synth.sh (rtx8000, 1 GPU, 3 CPUs, 128G, 8 h). Nothing is written into a run directory. Depends on FEAT-003 (SynthConfig wiring) and FEAT-002 (synthesis).
steps: runtime/fixed_data.py: `ValidationSet.build(..., global_transform=None, group_images_fn=None)` -> `src = images[idx] if group_images_fn is None else group_images_fn(g, idx)` before `render_group(src, T, spacing)`; `build_validation_sets(..., group_images_fn=None)` passes it to both the plain and the `_g` sets; `DeformValidationSet.build(..., seed=1234, group_images_fn=None)` -> images from the hook, labels unchanged (train18). Default path byte-identical (no extra RNG use). Docstrings.

data_loading/synth.py: `EVAL_PRESETS` (11 names: random_0, random_1, random_2, random_3, t2_like, flair_like, fdg_like, amyloid_pos, amyloid_neg, tau_like, t1_like) as dicts of train18 class means (19 entries, background 0), optional fine-id overrides by DK parcel name (resolved through `preprocessing.luts.DK_PARCELS` to synthfine ids for both hemispheres: e.g. tau_like high in entorhinal, parahippocampal, fusiform, inferiortemporal, middletemporal; amyloid_pos cortex ~ WM high and cerebellum cortex low), blur FWHM (fdg 5 mm, amyloid/tau 6 mm, MR presets from the MR family), within-class std and the per-image jitter as in training; random_* = the training distribution (draw_synth_params with SynthConfig defaults, hier_dev 0.1 / hier_dev_cortex 0.25 per OD1) with seed index 0..3. `preset_params(name, n, seed, cfg, level)` -> the same params dict structure `synthesize_group` consumes, deterministic from (name, seed) via `tf.random.Generator.from_seed` / stateless seeds; document preset values in the module docstring.

runtime/eval_run.py (new): (1) `load_run_config(run_dir)` reads <run>/config.json (path rule of `inference.loader._read_config` / `C.source_config_path` for <run>/ckpt/last), normalises every `*_parsed` value recursively (decimal-string dict keys -> int), returns (argparse.Namespace(**args), raw config); `train_config_for_eval(ns)` = `A.train_config_from_args(ns)` with val PNGs off (missing synth_* fields -> synth None). (2) `build_trainer(run_dir, ns, raw_cfg, data_root)`: model + frozen stages exactly like the resume branch of main.main (GroupRegLevelModel(...).build_model, FrozenChain.from_config / FrozenStage.from_config for cascade runs), Trainer with placeholder sources whose `next()` raises, restore `<run>/ckpt/last` through `C.RunCheckpoint` (no save calls), re-apply BN freeze when the saved `bn_recalibration.freeze` is true; never writes into run_dir. (3) `real_val_sets(ns, data_root)` = the validation sets of `main._build_dali_data` without DALI (fd.load_level_images / load_level_images_and_labels + build_validation_sets / DeformValidationSet.build with the run's val settings). (4) `sanity_gate(trainer, val_sets, run_dir, step)`: `trainer.validate()` vs the run's logged validation at the checkpoint step from logs/metrics.jsonl; returns {max_mm_diff, max_dice_diff, pass} with tolerances 1e-2 mm / 1e-3 Dice. (5) `synthetic_val_sets(preset, real_spec, fine_labels, data_root, ...)`: builds the synthetic sets on the CPU (tf.device('/cpu:0')) with fixed seeds per (preset, group, image) through the group_images_fn hooks; names `synth_<preset>_<real set name>`; sha256 per set. (6) `run_eval(runs, level, out_dir, presets, data_root, sanity_gate_on)`: both trainers resident, per preset build the sets ONCE and assign `trainer.val_sets = sets` for each model before `validate()`, free before the next preset, record ru_maxrss after each preset, write eval_synth.json (all metrics per run and preset, shared-set flag, sha256, sanity gate results, spec per run) and a paired CSV (real-only vs mixed per preset and metric). Exit code 5 on a failed sanity gate.

eval_synth.py (top level, like predict.py): argparse `--runs RUN [RUN ...]` (1 or 2 run dirs), `--level 1` (must equal each run's level), `--out DIR` (required, created, must not be inside a run dir), `--presets` (comma list, default all), `--data` (default: each run's saved args.data), `--sanity-gate on|off` (default on; off for tests only), `--quiet`; configures TF precision like main.py (TF32 off, memory growth); calls runtime.eval_run.run_eval; `--help` must work without importing TF at module import time (import TF inside main()). scripts/compare_synth_eval.py: re-prints the paired table from one eval_synth.json; with two JSONs asserts equal sha256 per preset and set (error naming the preset on mismatch). Both py3.8, stdlib + numpy only for compare.

slurm/eval_synth.sh (new, style of slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh): `#SBATCH -A qtim`, `-p rtx8000`, `--gpus=1`, `-N 1`, `--ntasks-per-node=1`, `--cpus-per-task=3`, `--mem=128G`, `--time=08:00:00`, logs under $PROJ/logs; env RUNS (required, space-separated run dirs), LEVEL (1), OUT (default $PROJ/results/eval_synth/$JOB_ID), PRESETS (empty = all), DATA (empty = runs' own); validation -> die exit 2; BGR_DRY_RUN=1 prints `MAIN: python eval_synth.py ...` and exits before any write; real run in the container with --nv, then appends `sstat -j $SLURM_JOB_ID.batch --format=MaxRSS` output to $OUT/sstat.txt; header with the usage line `RUNS="<real-only config B L1 run> $R/r1_cfgB_synth05" sbatch --job-name=evalsyn --time=08:00:00 --mem=128G slurm/eval_synth.sh` and 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval'.

tests/test_eval_synth.py (new; TF): config round trip (a saved config.json with `cascade_skip_stage_parsed {"deform": {"4": 0.15}}` -> normalised int keys; TrainConfig equal to the one from the original Namespace; an old config without synth_* -> synth None); presets: all 11 build params with the expected shapes, deterministic per seed, random_* use hier_dev_cortex 0.25 on cortical ids, PET presets apply their parcel overrides; two presets give distinct set names `synth_<preset>_<set>` and distinct `Trainer._identity_cache` keys, and their identity entries (template_dice_identity / ncc_template_identity or the keys the trainer actually stores, check run.py ~1526-1577) differ; group_images_fn hooks: default None reproduces today's ValidationSet / DeformValidationSet bit for bit, a hook replaces only the images; tiny integration: build a TINY level-4 run directory (train a few steps with a fixed-source Trainer + RunCheckpoint + C.write_config, or main.py --overfit-one-group --overfit-synthetic with TINY_ARGS), a fake export with fine labels (write_fake_export(labels=True, fine_labels=True)), run `eval_synth.py --runs <run> <run> --level 4 --presets random_0,t2_like --data <export> --out <tmp> --sanity-gate off` -> exit 0, eval_synth.json has both runs x presets, shared sets (equal sha256 for both runs), CSV exists, run dir unchanged (file listing + mtimes). tests/test_slurm_scripts.py: eval_synth.sh header/policy + dry-run argv test. tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: add eval_synth.py, runtime/eval_run.py (already via runtime/*.py), scripts/compare_synth_eval.py to PYFILES and slurm/eval_synth.sh to the bash -n loop; add tests.test_eval_synth to nothing else (it is a TF module picked up by the per-module loop).

For the final integration / report: (1) final eval command (slurm/eval_synth.sh header): `RUNS="<real-only config B L1 run> $R/r1_cfgB_synth05" sbatch --job-name=evalsyn --time=08:00:00 --mem=128G slurm/eval_synth.sh` (rtx8000, -A qtim, 1 GPU, 3 CPUs, 128G, 8 h; env RUNS required, LEVEL 1, OUT default $PROJ/results/eval_synth/<job>, PRESETS empty = all 11, DATA empty = runs' saved args.data); needs the synthfine val labels (export-add-labels). (2) Output: <OUT>/eval_synth.json (runs with label = run dir basename, '#2' suffix if duplicated; sanity_gate per run; results[preset].runs[label].{metrics, sha256}; shared_sets; ru_maxrss_kb; exit_code) + eval_synth.csv (preset, metric, one column per run, diff = second - first) + sstat.txt. Exit codes 0 / 2 (usage, run, level mismatch, missing synthfine) / 5 (sanity gate: every *_mm metric within 1e-2, every *dice* within 1e-3 vs logs/metrics.jsonl at the ckpt/last step; JSON written, no preset run). (3) Design choices to list in impl-report: named presets have NO random parcel deviation (fixed class means + DK parcel overrides), re-mask on, gamma 1, std/jitter/FWHM jitter/bias/noise drawn as in training; MR presets draw the group FWHM from U(0, 3) mm; random_* = draw_synth_params with SynthConfig() defaults (prob forced 1). Synthetic contrast seed per group = TASK_SEED[task] * 100000 + g (rigid 1, affine 2, deform 3), so a task's _g set shares its plain set's images. Synthetic sets built under tf.device('/cpu:0') (incl. rendering); real gate sets built exactly as main._build_dali_data (default device). AMP runs build and validate under policy_scope('mixed_float16'). (4) No full-suite run yet (final integration step); tests/run_tests_wsl.sh now also covers eval_synth.py, scripts/compare_synth_eval.py, slurm/eval_synth.sh and the eval_synth.py --help no-TF check. (5) Not exercised locally: a cascade (level 2 / 1) run through eval (FrozenStage / FrozenChain restore + fingerprint check reuse main._check_cascade_fingerprint(s)); a passing sanity gate on real logged validation (cluster only).
